vsm2.20:43.1: Yathā ca rūpaṃ sammasantena rūpassa nibbatti passitabbā,
vsm2.20:43.2: evaṃ arūpaṃ sammasantenapi arūpassa nibbatti passitabbā.
vsm2.20:43.4: Seyyathidaṃ – idañhi arūpaṃ nāma purimabhave āyūhitakammavasena paṭisandhiyaṃ tāva
vsm2.20:43.9: Yaṃ tattha kāmāvacaraṃ, taṃ chasu dvāresu balavārammaṇe tadārammaṇavasena.
vsm2.20:44.1: Pavatte pana asambhinnattā cakkhussa āpāthagatattā rūpānaṃ
vsm2.20:44.2: ālokasannissitaṃ manasikārahetukaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ nibbattati saddhiṃ sampayuttadhammehi.
vsm2.20:44.5: Tasmiṃ ghaṭṭite dvikkhattuṃ bhavaṅgaṃ uppajjitvā nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:44.6: Tato tasmiṃyeva ārammaṇe kiriyamanodhātu āvajjanakiccaṃ sādhayamānā uppajjati.
vsm2.20:44.7: Tadanantaraṃ tadeva rūpaṃ passamānaṃ kusalavipākaṃ akusalavipākaṃ vā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:44.10: Tato tadeva rūpaṃ vavatthāpayamānā kiriyāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātu upekkhāsahagatā.
vsm2.20:44.11: Tato paraṃ kāmāvacarakusalākusalakiriyacittesu ekaṃ vā upekkhāsahagatāhetukaṃ cittaṃ
vsm2.20:44.17: Evaṃ chasu dvāresu arūpassa nibbatti passitabbā.
vsm2.20:44.18: Evañhi arūpassa nibbattiṃ passanto kālena arūpaṃ sammasati nāma.
vsm2.20:45.1: Evaṃ kālena rūpaṃ kālena arūpaṃ sammasitvāpi tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā
vsm2.20:46.1: Aparo rūpasattakaarūpasattakavasena tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā saṅkhāre sammasati.
vsm2.20:46.8: dhammatārūpatoti imehi ākārehi āropetvā sammasanto rūpasattakavasena āropetvā sammasati nāma.
vsm2.20:47.3: Iti yogāvacaro imehi ādānanikkhepehi ekaṃ vassasataṃ paricchinditvā saṅkhāresu tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:47.5: Kasmā? Uppādavayavattito, vipariṇāmato, tāvakālikato, niccapaṭikkhepato ca.
vsm2.20:47.6: Yasmā pana uppannā saṅkhārā ṭhitiṃ pāpuṇanti, ṭhitiyaṃ jarāya kilamanti, jaraṃ patvā avassaṃ bhijjanti,
vsm2.20:47.7: tasmā abhiṇhasampaṭipīḷanato, dukkhamato dukkhavatthuto, sukhapaṭikkhepato ca dukkhā.
vsm2.20:47.8: Yasmā ca ‘‘uppannā saṅkhārā ṭhitiṃ mā pāpuṇantu, ṭhānappattā mā jīrantu, jarappattā mā bhijjantū’’ti imesu tīsu ṭhānesu kassaci vasavattibhāvo natthi,
vsm2.20:47.9: suññā tena vasavattanākārena, tasmā suññato, assāmikato, avasavattito, attapaṭikkhepato ca anattāti.
vsm2.20:48.1: Evaṃ ādānanikkhepanavasena vassasataparicchinne rūpe tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā tato paraṃ vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato āropeti.
vsm2.20:48.2: Tattha vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamo nāma vayavasena vuḍḍhassa vaḍḍhitassa rūpassa atthaṅgamo.
vsm2.20:49.1: So tameva vassasataṃ paṭhamavayena majjhimavayena pacchimavayenāti tīhi vayehi paricchindati.
vsm2.20:49.2: Tattha ādito tettiṃsa vassāni paṭhamavayo nāma.
vsm2.20:49.5: Iti imehi tīhi vayehi paricchinditvā, ‘‘paṭhamavaye pavattaṃ rūpaṃ majjhimavayaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati, tasmā taṃ aniccaṃ.
vsm2.20:49.6: Yadaniccaṃ, taṃ dukkhaṃ. Yaṃ dukkhaṃ, tadanattā.
vsm2.20:49.7: Majjhimavaye pavattarūpampi pacchimavayaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati, tasmā tampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā.
vsm2.20:49.8: Pacchimavaye tettiṃsa vassāni pavattarūpampi maraṇato paraṃ gamanasamatthaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā tampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:50.1: Evaṃ paṭhamavayādivasena vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā puna
vsm2.20:50.3: hānidasakaṃ, pabbhāradasakaṃ, vaṅkadasakaṃ, momūhadasakaṃ, sayanadasaka’’nti imesaṃ dasannaṃ dasakānaṃ vasena vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:51.1: Tattha dasakesu tāva vassasatajīvino puggalassa paṭhamāni dasa vassāni mandadasakaṃ nāma, tadā hi so mando hoti capalo kumārako.
vsm2.20:51.2: Tato parāni dasa khiḍḍādasakaṃ nāma, tadā hi so khiḍḍāratibahulo hoti.
vsm2.20:51.3: Tato parāni dasa vaṇṇadasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa vaṇṇāyatanaṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti.
vsm2.20:51.4: Tato parāni dasa baladasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa balañca thāmo ca vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti.
vsm2.20:51.5: Tato parāni dasa paññādasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa paññā suppatiṭṭhitā hoti, pakatiyā kira dubbalapaññassāpi tasmiṃ kāle appamattakā paññā uppajjatiyeva.
vsm2.20:51.6: Tato parāni dasa hānidasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa khiḍḍārativaṇṇabalapaññā parihāyanti.
vsm2.20:51.7: Tato parāni dasa pabbhāradasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa attabhāvo purato pabbhāro hoti.
vsm2.20:51.8: Tato parāni dasa vaṅkadasakaṃ nāma, tadā hissa attabhāvo naṅgalakoṭi viya vaṅko hoti.
vsm2.20:51.9: Tato parāni dasa momūhadasakaṃ nāma. Tadā hi so momūho hoti, kataṃ kataṃ pamussati.
vsm2.20:51.10: Tato parāni dasa sayanadasakaṃ nāma, vassasatiko hi sayanabahulova hoti.
vsm2.20:52.1: Tatrāyaṃ yogī etesaṃ dasakānaṃ vasena vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetuṃ iti paṭisañcikkhati
vsm2.20:52.2: ‘‘paṭhamadasake pavattarūpaṃ dutiyadasakaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati, tasmā taṃ aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā.
vsm2.20:52.3: Dutiyadasake…pe… navamadasake pavattarūpaṃ dasamadasakaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:52.4: Dasamadasake pavattarūpaṃ punabbhavaṃ appatvā idheva nirujjhati, tasmā tampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:53.1: Evaṃ dasakavasena vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā puna
vsm2.20:53.2: tadeva vassasataṃ pañcapañcavassavasena vīsatikoṭṭhāse katvā vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:54.2: ‘‘paṭhame vassapañcake pavattarūpaṃ dutiyaṃ vassapañcakaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati, tasmā taṃ aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā.
vsm2.20:54.3: Dutiye vassapañcake pavattarūpaṃ tatiyaṃ…pe… ekūnavīsatime vassapañcake pavattarūpaṃ vīsatimaṃ vassapañcakaṃ appatvā tattheva nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:54.4: Vīsatime vassapañcake pavattarūpaṃ maraṇato paraṃ gamanasamatthaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā tampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti.
vsm2.20:55.1: Evaṃ vīsatikoṭṭhāsavasena vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamato tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā puna
vsm2.20:55.2: pañcavīsati koṭṭhāse katvā catunnaṃ catunnaṃ vassānaṃ vasena āropeti.
vsm2.20:55.3: Tato tettiṃsa koṭṭhāse katvā tiṇṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ vasena,
vsm2.20:55.4: paññāsa koṭṭhāse katvā dvinnaṃ dvinnaṃ vassānaṃ vasena,
vsm2.20:55.6: Tato ekaṃ vassaṃ tayo koṭṭhāse katvā vassānahemantagimhesu tīsu utūsu ekekautuvasena tasmiṃ vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamarūpe tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:56.1: Kathaṃ? ‘‘Vassāne catumāsaṃ pavattarūpaṃ hemantaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ.
vsm2.20:56.2: Hemante pavattarūpaṃ gimhaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ.
vsm2.20:56.3: Gimhe pavattarūpaṃ puna vassānaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ, tasmā taṃ aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti.
vsm2.20:57.1: Evaṃ āropetvā puna ekaṃ vassaṃ cha koṭṭhāse katvā
vsm2.20:57.2: ‘‘vassāne dvemāsaṃ pavattarūpaṃ saradaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ.
vsm2.20:57.3: Sarade pavattarūpaṃ hemantaṃ. Hemante pavattarūpaṃ sisiraṃ. Sisire pavattarūpaṃ vasantaṃ.
vsm2.20:57.4: Vasante pavattarūpaṃ gimhaṃ. Gimhe pavattarūpaṃ puna vassānaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ, tasmā aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti evaṃ tasmiṃ vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamarūpe tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:58.3: Juṇhe pavattarūpaṃ kāḷaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ, tasmā aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:59.3: Divasaṃ pavattarūpampi rattiṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ, tasmā aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
vsm2.20:60.1: Tato tadeva rattindivaṃ pubbaṇhādivasena cha koṭṭhāse katvā –
vsm2.20:60.6: Majjhimayāme pavattarūpaṃ pacchimayāmaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ.
vsm2.20:60.7: Pacchimayāme pavattarūpaṃ puna pubbaṇhaṃ appatvā tattheva niruddhaṃ, tasmā aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti tilakkhaṇaṃ āropeti.
